tables.name: files
tables.label: Files
tables.description: Every file in the suite, of any type, in one place. A file's `kind` decides which tool opens it: doc → Docs, note → Notes, sheets → Sheets, wireframe → Wireframe. Folders (kind = folder) nest files into a tree. Docs and notes keep their content in `body`; sheets and wireframes open as their own tool instance keyed to the file, so the file list holds everything while each tool owns its data.
